notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
The product version has been released.
Teach your Friends puzzles and dive into the world of Ai!

notes.title: The trial version has been updated to Ver1.2!
notes.notes:
The contents of the update are as follows

- Addition of chain support function
- Simple and easy-to-understand display of AI moves with a Icon
- Improvement of overall game progression and other bug fixes

We hope you continue to enjoy BlockWorld Ai.
